record.title: Evaluate revised ADC stock capture admission
record.intent: Decide whether accepted native controls and repaired health finalization support the bounded stock observation.
requirements: Confirm all original private native controls remain accepted and the source-reviewed repair affects orchestration only; do not reinterpret omitted generic private health as a measurement.

Confirm new-mode success and failure controls, mandatory stock health verification, source pins and the preboot disk gate. Admit stock only if this bounded continuation is supported; otherwise record the exact blocker.
Record and push the admission decision before any stock guest execution. No new hardware response or ADC call execution is authorized by this gate.
acceptance: A committed evidence-based stock admission or explicit blocker is recorded.
